title: Andio language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sulawesi, Indonesia
extract: Andio (Andio’o), or Masama, is an Austronesian language spoken at the tip of the eastern peninsula of the island of Sulawesi, Indonesia. It belongs to the Saluan–Banggai branch of the Celebic subgroup.
